column1: # One TSV row per child. Columns are TAB-separated. Lines starting with
# '#' and blank lines are ignored. Edit this file to add/remove children;
# `airgenome-supervisor reload` (SIGHUP) re-reads it without process restart.
#   1. label       — short id (used in logs; e.g. "tap"). Must be unique.
#   6. envfile     — path to a shell-source-able env file (or "-" for none)
#   9. cmd         — the command line; whitespace-split into argv
#   - reset to throttle after >60s of clean uptime
#   - exit code 0 with KeepAliveOnSuccess=false semantics is honored only
#     for the "tap" job (its plist sets KeepAlive.SuccessfulExit=false);
